headline.title: The latest AI news we announced in April 2026
headline.summary: In April 2026, a new AI video mockup was announced, showcasing mobile capabilities alongside an underwater video feature. The announcement highlights advancements in AI technology for video production and mobile applications.

articles.title: GameStop offers $56 billion for eBay, struggles to explain how it'll pay for it
articles.summary: GameStop has proposed a $56 billion acquisition of eBay, despite facing declining revenue and store closures. The company has not provided a clear explanation of how it plans to finance the purchase.

articles.title: Week one of the Musk v. Altman trial: What it was like in the room
articles.summary: The trial between Elon Musk and Sam Altman commenced in Oakland, California, as Musk sues OpenAI over claims related to his financial contributions. The proceedings highlight the ongoing tensions between two influential figures in the AI industry.

articles.title: Sierra raises $950M as the race to own enterprise AI gets serious
articles.summary: Sierra has successfully raised $950 million, bringing its total funding to over $1 billion, which it plans to use to establish itself as the "global standard" for AI-powered customer experiences. This funding marks a significant step in the competitive landscape of enterprise AI development.

articles.title: Image AI models now drive app growth, beating chatbot upgrades
articles.summary: A recent report by Appfigures reveals that launches of image AI models lead to 6.5 times more app downloads compared to chatbot upgrades; however, the majority of these apps fail to convert the increased downloads into revenue. This highlights a disparity between user acquisition and monetization in the app market.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s only AI expert witness at the OpenAI trial fears an AGI arms race
articles.summary: Stuart Russell, Elon Musk's sole AI expert witness in the OpenAI trial, has expressed concerns about an impending AGI arms race and advocates for government regulation of advanced AI labs. His testimony highlights the need for oversight to mitigate potential risks associated with the rapid development of artificial intelligence technologies.

articles.title: 5 days only: Bring a partner or colleague and get 50% off a second TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass
articles.summary: TechCrunch is offering a limited-time promotion where purchasing one pass to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 allows buyers to receive 50% off a second pass of the same type. This buy-one-get-one offer is available until Friday, May 8.

articles.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
articles.summary: Elon Musk and Sam Altman are currently engaged in a court battle regarding the direction of OpenAI, with Musk alleging that the organization has strayed from its original mission to prioritize profit over the development of beneficial AI. The trial, which began recently, could have significant implications for OpenAI and its flagship product, ChatGPT.

articles.title: Elon Musk sent ominous texts to Greg Brockman, Sam Altman after asking for a settlement, OpenAI claims
articles.summary: Elon Musk reportedly sent threatening texts to OpenAI's president Greg Brockman and CEO Sam Altman, warning that they would become "the most hated men in America" if a lawsuit was not settled. This claim was made by OpenAI in response to Musk's request for a settlement.

articles.title: DoorDash adds AI tools to speed up merchant onboarding, edit photos of dishes
articles.summary: DoorDash has introduced AI tools designed to streamline the onboarding process for merchants, enhance food photography, and generate new websites using existing content. These features aim to improve the overall experience for both merchants and customers on the platform.

articles.title: The creator of Roomba is back with a furry robot companion
articles.summary: Colin Angle, known for creating the Roomba, has launched a new robotic companion designed to resemble a dog. This product, developed by his new company Familiar Machines & Magic, aims to provide companionship rather than perform household cleaning tasks.

articles.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are both launching joint ventures for enterprise AI services
articles.summary: Anthropic and OpenAI have formed partnerships with asset managers to enhance the marketing of their enterprise AI services. This collaboration aims to expand their reach and offerings in the growing AI market for businesses.
